name: Hazon Vines

contact.note: Not yet contacted. Boutique estate in Broederstroom, Hartbeespoort, under the Magalies Mountains. Contact details are on the site's contact page; no generic business alias was confirmed, so none recorded here.

delivery.note: Free delivery on orders over R1,150 anywhere in South Africa via The Courier Guy (per the Cabernet Franc 2022 product page). Free collection from the estate is also offered. A ~24-bottle order clears the threshold easily; check whether a small top-up order would not. A dedicated delivery page was not found (404), so the threshold is confirmed from the product page only.

constraints: Recommended by the contributor as a strong vendor: a boutique, single-estate producer rather than a bottle-shop reseller.
House flagship and contributor's personal favourite from the range: Cabernet Franc 2022 (100% Cabernet Franc, SKU HV-CBF-2022), R450 per bottle, with 10% off a case of 6 (R2,430).

Range seen: reds (incl. Cabernet Franc, Shiraz, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Pinotage, Cinsault), whites (Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc, Chenin Blanc) and rosé. Red prices run roughly R195 per bottle up to a case at R2,052; whites roughly R125 per bottle up to a case at R1,188.

Price fit: entry bottles sit near a day-to-day budget, while the flagship Cabernet Franc is a 'feeling lush' tier bottle; budget-as-average (METHODOLOGY rule 2) applies, so pair it with cheaper bottles in the same order.
Not yet confirmed: whether single bottles ship free below the threshold, and stock levels per vintage.
